headline: desired_capacity cannot be less than min_size — this won't scale down

findings.evidence_ref: compute.tf line 29: desired_capacity changed to 1, but min_size remains 3
findings.explanation: When desired_capacity is set below min_size, AWS ignores it and maintains min_size instances instead. The ASG will keep running 3 instances, defeating the cost savings goal. To scale down overnight, min_size must also be reduced to 1, or use scheduled actions to set different min/desired/max at different times.
